assessment: Using the mouse secondary palate as a model, this study reports original findings on the function of Kdm6b, a H3K27me3 demethylase, in the regulation of embryonic development. The authors show that Kdm6b plays an essential role in neural crest development, and that loss of Kdm6b perturbs the p53 pathway, leading to complete clefting of the secondary palate along with cell proliferation and differentiation defects.
